label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows directly into the SQL query via concatenation without effective neutralization. The doSomething function uses a list manipulation technique (add three strings, remove index 0, take index 1) which preserves the second element (the original param), allowing XSS/SQLi payload execution. Although ESAPI encoder is applied later, CodeQL correctly identifies the unsanitized concatenation point as vulnerable.

evidence.note: User input flows through doSomething to SQL concatenation without proper sanitization
